app.name: Dual Shared Board
app.description: WebMCP tools for the page-aware portion of the executable DUAL shared-operation fixture.

tools.name: inspect_visible_board
tools.title: Inspect visible board
tools.description: Read the items and revision shown on the currently open board page without modifying it.

successEvidence: The result contains board identity, items, and revision.

tools.name: add_visible_board_item
tools.title: Add item to visible board
tools.description: Commit one titled item through the canonical board operation when the supplied revision is current, then reconcile the open page.

preconditions: expectedRevision matches the durable board revision.
semantics.visibleEffect: The visible board reconciles the committed item and durable revision.
successEvidence: The result contains item, durable revision, and commit ID.

tools.name: select_visible_board_item
tools.title: Select visible board item
tools.description: Select an existing item in the open board page without changing the durable board record.

itemId.description: ID of an item visible in the open board.

semantics.visibleEffect: The matching item becomes the visible page selection without changing durable board state.
successEvidence: The result and visible page identify the same selected item.
failureModes: The item is no longer visible.
